editions.label: 1st edition
editions.tagline: The foundation: sorting, graphs, data structures, complexity and numerical algorithms — plus hardware-flavoured chapters later dropped.

added.text: Sorting networks (comparison, bitonic and odd-even merge)
Boyer–Moore string matching and optimal polygon triangulation

editions.label: 2nd edition
editions.tagline: Clifford Stein joins as author; randomized analysis, linear programming and perfect hashing arrive.

added.text: Randomized algorithms and probabilistic analysis chapter
Assembly-line scheduling and optimal binary search trees

removed.text: Boyer–Moore and optimal polygon triangulation sections
Hoare partitioning as the main quicksort partition (kept as a problem)

editions.label: 3rd edition
editions.tagline: C-like pseudocode, multithreaded algorithms, van Emde Boas trees and a matrix appendix.

added.text: Rod cutting replaces assembly-line scheduling; seam carving and Viterbi problems

editions.label: 4th edition
editions.tagline: New chapters on machine learning, online algorithms and bipartite matching; rarely taught material removed.

added.text: Machine learning: k-means, weighted majority, gradient descent
Online algorithms: competitive analysis, caching, move-to-front
Matchings in bipartite graphs: Hopcroft–Karp, Hungarian, stable marriage
Suffix arrays and the Akra–Bazzi recurrence method

removed.text: Maximum subarray, implementing pointers and objects, perfect hashing, randomly built BSTs
Matroids, push-relabel max-flow, iterative FFT, detailed simplex, integer factorization
